description: Suggestions register: options for improving decision-making. Nothing here is implemented - each stays 'proposed' until a reviewer chooses it. Ordered by what they unblock.
workflow: proposed -> reviewed -> chosen -> implemented. This desk implements nothing from this list in this session.

rows.title: Acquire an official timestamped price feed
rows.improves: Unblocks REQ-01 market open/close columns, REQ-04 market/difference columns, the CLV demotion gate (D1), and any ROI claim that can be called official.
rows.impact: critical - everything price-based is blocked behind it
rows.risk: cost and jurisdiction; the NFL's official feed goes to operators via an exclusive distributor
rows.discovery: Ask what licensed channels exist (operator data APIs, state-regulator published lines, exchange feeds); confirm permitted use before purchase.

rows.title: Automate official results capture for every week
rows.improves: Completes REQ-02: pending weeks 1-6 (93 games) and future weeks enter the verified feed without hand transcription.
rows.impact: high - backtests need full official outcomes
rows.risk: page structure changes break the parser; keep per-row source links
rows.discovery: Prototype against week-1..6 schedule pages already linked in results_feed.json pending rows.
rows.source_label: NFL.com week schedule pattern (linked per pending row)

rows.title: Second capture of our own line at kickoff
rows.improves: Completes the our-open / our-close pair in REQ-01 (currently 45 open, 0 close).
rows.impact: medium - makes our own price movement measurable
rows.risk: needs a stable run time tied to kickoff
rows.discovery: Schedule compute-style capture at kickoff minus 60 minutes for each slate game.

rows.title: Source replacement depth from official team sites
rows.improves: Unblocks REQ-06 string tiers: team-published depth charts (club sites) are the only semi-official depth source; each row would cite the club URL.
rows.impact: high - depth deficiency signal becomes measurable
rows.risk: club charts are often stamped 'unofficial' and stale (sibling flag FL-DD-02)
rows.discovery: Audit which of the 32 club sites publish a dated depth chart; record URL + stamp per club; keep blank where none exists.

rows.title: Pick one canonical originator
rows.improves: Two committed pipelines publish different 'our' lines for the same games (gap 1.5-9.0 pts, FL-LD-07). One canonical source removes ambiguity from every published page.
rows.impact: high - prevents quoting two different model lines
rows.risk: retiring one output may break sibling pages that read it
rows.discovery: Compare data/derived/model.json vs results/originate.json on the 15-game slate (already computed) and choose; document on the root method page.

rows.title: Make the root leaderboard signal-only
rows.improves: Removes ROI from the root ranking rule ('gates, then ROI') so staking luck cannot influence order anywhere (PS-F3).
rows.risk: root pages owned by another session - needs their acceptance
rows.discovery: Offer line-desk/data/leaderboard.json as the replacement ranking block to the root owner.

rows.title: Extend official correlations to more seasons
rows.improves: REQ-07 window grows beyond 2025-2026 (n 64 -> 96, 128...), tightening every interval.
rows.risk: hand transcription error; verify totals against published net points
rows.discovery: Transcribe 2024, 2023... standings from the same NFL.com URL pattern; run compute.py.
rows.source_label: same official URL pattern for prior seasons

rows.title: Fund or formally cancel the reward pool
rows.improves: The leaderboard advertises reward tiers with 0 funding; deciding ends a standing irregularity (FL-LD-09).
rows.risk: funding raises jurisdiction/eligibility questions (see sibling Q07)
rows.discovery: Decide: publish 'paper rewards only' or fund a pool with terms reviewed for jurisdiction.

rows.title: Run demotion gates as a scheduled job
rows.improves: Once any strategy goes live, D1/D2 evaluate on a schedule instead of at review time.
rows.risk: cannot run until REQ-01 price feed exists (D1) and a strategy is live
rows.discovery: Wire line-desk/scripts/gates dry-run into CI once P1-P3 can pass.

rows.title: Consolidate the suggestion/question hubs
rows.improves: Eight-plus hubs publish overlapping suggestion registers with colliding IDs; one canonical index (or one ID namespace) stops reviewer confusion.
rows.risk: cross-session coordination; no hub owner wants to be demoted to archive
rows.discovery: Use review-board's de-duplicated queue as the canonical list and link the others from it.

rows.title: Add line-desk to root navigation
rows.improves: Discoverability of this desk's pages from the root landing page.
rows.risk: root nav owned by the integration session; open PRs touch it - request logged, not edited
rows.discovery: Root owner adds line-desk/index.html to scripts/lib/site.py NAV after merge (request in COORDINATION.md).

rows.title: Remove the committed Python virtual environment
rows.improves: .venv-b6 (6,214 tracked files) bloats every clone and diff; removing it speeds all sessions' work.
rows.risk: a sibling PR (#97) currently touches those files - coordinate first
rows.discovery: git rm -r --cached .venv-b6, add to .gitignore, confirm CI uses its own environment.
